canonical_name: buddy_alloc -- a header-only buddy memory allocator (Stanislav Paskalev)
lineage: Buddy allocation (Knowlton 1965, Knuth): split memory into power-of-two blocks, merge free 'buddies' on release; the allocator behind many kernels' page allocators, trading internal fragmentation for O(log n) alloc/free and fast coalescing
version: github.com/spaskalev/buddy_alloc master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)
build_system: header-only; compile a Techne driver (or the repo's own tests)
entry_points: buddy_init / buddy_malloc / buddy_free over a fixed arena

example.command: the repo's own tests, or a Techne driver: allocate/free within a fixed arena, exercise buddy split/merge, check no overlap and successful coalescing
example.input: an allocation workload in a bounded arena
example.output: all blocks valid; the arena coalesces back to free

upstream_docs: Knowlton, A Fast Storage Allocator, CACM 1965

human_capability_summary.built_to: allocate and free memory from a FIXED arena in power-of-two blocks, merging freed buddies so large blocks become available again -- fast coalescing under a hard capacity bound
human_capability_summary.pressure: a fixed, bounded arena (no asking the OS for more) where fragmentation must be fought or large requests fail while small free blocks litter the arena
human_capability_summary.success_means: requests satisfied while any contiguous block of the size exists, with bounded internal fragmentation and O(log n) operations

known_human_problem_solved: fixed-arena allocation with fast coalescing (the buddy system)
human_environmental_pressure: a fixed memory arena, fragmentation, mixed allocation sizes
human_failure_condition: fragmentation defeats it: a large request fails though enough total memory is free (just not contiguous); the kernel/embedded system runs out of usable memory
behavioral_entry_point: allocate many small blocks then a large one, freeing in an adversarial order, to induce fragmentation failure in the bounded arena

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run buddy-alloc-spaskalev
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: allocate and free memory from a FIXED arena in power-of-two blocks, merging freed buddies so large blocks become available again -- fast coalescing under a hard capacity bound
